scope: Full Windows and Ubuntu CI for bounded current-file execution records, host-retained evidence and source navigation. Actual VS Code and packaged production installation use public fixtures and controlled model responses. Model semantic review is separate.

jobs.name: verify (windows-latest)

checks: Explanation execution records: actual worker records a source-linked return; nested client mutation cannot change host evidence or navigation, and invalid record indexes are rejected without model inference
Explanation observations: actual worker calculates selected JS/TS examples and preserves special values without contacting any model; invalid argument lists are rejected

Explanation observations: host-retained results, progress phases and a selected time limit reach the actual local-model client and returned view; invalid limits and fabricated observation fields cannot replace them; full source is preserved (model answer is controlled)

Explanation coverage: actual client returns separate input checks and caller requirements with every example; its citation opens exact source, duplicated or missing examples are rejected and source remains unchanged (controlled model response)
Explanation observations: wrong handles, edit tasks, different functions, superseded examples and an edited document are rejected before model inference; native undo restores exact source
